The week, in one breath

A 40-burger wasted, a champion exposed

Josh Allen produced the best individual performance of the young season, 40.82 points, and Romo’s Rum Runner lost by 29 anyway. One week after hanging a league-record 183.7, the Pirates of the CaribBijan face-planted to 66.7, the lowest score in the league. J9hunna, Honk Dawgs and The CMC all moved to 2–0, Jaxon Smith-Njigba single-handedly dragged lotes into the win column, and Puka Nacua scored exactly zero for a team that lost by 20.

Game Stories

Every matchup gets a case file, a culprit and one completely imagined quote.
Heartbreak

Allen scores 40.82 and loses by 29

Honk Dawgs def. Romo’s Rum Runner | 139.18 – 110.02

Honk · 2–0BY 29.16Romo · 0–2

Allen (40.82) and Jahmyr Gibbs (20.3) gave Romo’s Rum Runner a two-man artillery barrage, and Tee Higgins (12.0) chipped in. It bought them exactly nothing. Honk Dawgs answered with the week’s highest team score: Patrick Mahomes (28.98), Travis Kelce (20.6) and James Cook (20.4) formed a three-headed answer no single superhero could outrun.

The cruel footnote: Romo’s Rum Runner is 0–2 with 226.68 points for — more points than six teams in this league, including four that already own a win. The schedule is not a meritocracy. It is a mugger.

“Forty points from my quarterback and I’m 0–2. Put it on my tombstone.”Imagined postgame quote · Romo’s Rum Runner
Blowout

Adams and Goff throw a 65-point party

J9hunna def. Everybody Hurts | 137.18 – 107.16

J9 · 2–0BY 30.02Hurts · 0–2

Davante Adams (35.5) and Jared Goff (29.78) combined for 65.28 — within a point and a half of the entire Pirates roster’s 66.7 this week — and Jaylen Waddle (17.8) kept the pressure on. J9hunna even survived Dallas Goedert’s 0.9 at tight end, the fantasy equivalent of winning a drag race with the parking brake on.

Everybody Hurts was not helpless: Jonathan Taylor (27.2), Jalen Hurts (18.16) and George Kittle (16.0) all showed up. But the Detroit defense scored −1.0, and 107.16 was only good enough for seventh-best this week. Everybody Hurts falls to 0–2 with the second-most points against in the league (283.98). The name remains accurate.

“Goedert owes Adams a steak dinner. Several, actually.”Imagined postgame quote · J9hunna
Thriller

CeeDee and a defense win the week’s only nail-biter

Steven diggs def. Kings of New York | 128.3 – 120.62

Steven · 1–1BY 7.68Kings · 1–1

CeeDee Lamb (31.3), the New England defense (23.0) and Stefon Diggs (19.2) built the winning margin for Steven diggs — who needed every bit of it, because DJ Moore contributed −0.1. Winning with a negative starter is either depth or dumb luck, and the Gazette declines to investigate.

The Kings got 30.7 from Amon-Ra St. Brown, 16.2 from Derrick Henry and 14.2 from Sam LaPorta, and still lost. Their 120.62 is the highest losing score of the week — a crown made entirely of thorns.

“We scored 120 and lost. The crown is heavy and also on fire.”Imagined postgame quote · Kings of New York
Game Recap

The CMC does CMC things, stays perfect

The CMC def. lexxyfour | 120.06 – 98.72

CMC · 2–0BY 21.34lexxy · 0–2

Dak Prescott (29.76), DeVonta Smith (22.7) and Christian McCaffrey (20.6) all cleared 20 for The CMC, the kind of boring, repeatable production that wins leagues in December. Through two weeks The CMC has allowed just 147.94 points total — the stingiest mark in the league by a mile.

lexxyfour’s stars also performed: Ja’Marr Chase (23.0), Kenneth Walker (20.8) and Kyren Williams (14.7). The problem is everything after the stars. lexxyfour is 0–2, and the gap between the headliners and the help is becoming the whole story.

“Three guys over 20, again. It’s not luck if it’s a system.”Imagined postgame quote · The CMC

JSN is the entire lotes offense

lotes def. Mommas Home <3 | 99.54 – 79.16

lotes · 1–1BY 20.38Mommas · 1–1

Jaxon Smith-Njigba scored 38.0 of lotes’ 99.54. Omarion Hampton (16.5) and Jayden Daniels (14.74) helped, but this was a solo act: Colston Loveland (0.8) and Mike Washington (0.7) combined for 1.5 points, and lotes still won by 20. Mommas Home <3 never had a chance to answer, because Puka Nacua scored 0.0. Garrett Wilson (14.2), Chuba Hubbard (13.4) and Jaylen Warren (8.7) led a lineup whose supposed WR1 submitted a blank page. You cannot win a shootout with a starter-shaped hole in the boat.

“Jaxon gets the game ball. Puka gets a wellness check.”Imagined postgame quote · lotes
The Crash

From 183.7 to 66.7 in seven days

dellnuts def. Pirates of the CaribBijan | 79.18 – 66.7

dellnuts · 1–1BY 12.48Pirates · 1–1

Seven days ago the Pirates of the CaribBijan set the league record with 183.7. This week they scored 66.7 — the lowest total in the league — and lost to a dellnuts team that only managed 79.18 itself. Parker Washington (13.3) was their top scorer. Malik Nabers (0.6) and Jaxson Dart (0.8) combined for 1.4 points, which is not a stat line, it’s a cry for help.

dellnuts will take it: Dalton Kincaid (19.0) and Bucky Irving (11.0) did just enough on a day Justin Herbert posted only 9.88. A win is a win, even when it arrives wearing a fake mustache.

“We didn’t beat the record-holders. We beat whoever that was.”Imagined postgame quote · dellnuts
Fraud Watch · Case file

Pirates of the CaribBijan

Last week: greatest show in league history. This week: an inquiry.

In Week 1 the Pirates hung 183.7 — still the highest single-week score in this league’s young history. In Week 2 they scored 66.7, the lowest total on the board, a one-week collapse of 117.0 points. Their best starter was Parker Washington at 13.3. Malik Nabers posted 0.6. The starting quarterback posted 0.8. dellnuts beat them with 79.18, a score that would have lost to nine other teams this week.

The standings still show 250.4 points for — fourth in the league — because the record book remembers Week 1. The eye test remembers Sunday. Both cannot be the real Pirates, and Fraud Watch intends to find out which one shows up next.

183.7 → 66.7

Fraud Watch verdict: record-breakers or frauds? The case is wide open.

Trades

Completed · Week 2

⇄

Why it happened: J9hunna’s tight-end spot produced 0.9 points from Dallas Goedert in Week 2 — Henry arrives as the immediate patch. Steven diggs, fresh off winning a shootout, spends the roster spot on backfield upside instead. One team bought a floor; the other bought a lottery ticket.
